facts.text: Lizard Island Resort is set within a National Park and surrounded by 24 secluded white-sand beaches.
facts.excerpt: set within a pristine National Park and surrounded by 24 secluded white-sand beaches

facts.text: Lizard Island is the most northern resort on the Great Barrier Reef, surrounded by 1,000 hectares of National Park.
facts.excerpt: The most northern resort on the Great Barrier Reef, surrounded by powdery white beaches and 1,000 hectares of National Park

facts.text: Lizard Island is a continental island 28km from the North Queensland coast, surrounded by fringing reefs.
facts.excerpt: Lizard Island is a continental island situated 28km from the North Queensland coast and is surrounded by fringing reefs

facts.text: The Clam Gardens are a short swim from the beach at Watson's Bay, with other snorkel sites at Anchor Bay and Sunset Beach.
facts.excerpt: The “Clam Gardens” are only a short swim from the beach at Watson’s Bay, and excellent sites are also located at Anchor Bay, and Sunset Beach.

facts.text: Dive sites such as the Cod Hole are 45 minutes from shore.
facts.excerpt: Lizard Island is located on the Great Barrier Reef with world famous dive sites, such as the Cod Hole, only 45 minutes from shore.

facts.text: Guests can hike in the footsteps of Captain Cook to Cook's Look, the highest point on the island, for panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: Hike in the footsteps of Captain Cook to the highest point on the island and take in the panoramic views

facts.text: Guests can take a private dinghy with a refreshments pack and motor to a beach of their choice.
facts.excerpt: take a private dinghy and motor to a beach of your choice

facts.text: Daily dining is included in the nightly rate.
facts.excerpt: In addition to your daily dining which is included in your nightly rate

facts.text: Beachside degustation dining takes place in two private gazebos on the shore of Anchor Bay facing the sunsets.
facts.excerpt: Two private gazebos are perfectly positioned on the shore of Anchor Bay, commanding spectacular views of the nightly sunsets.

facts.text: The Beachfront Suites are set along the arc of Anchor Bay with direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: Set along the natural arc of Anchor Bay, the Beachfront Suites are designed to offer uninterrupted beach access.

facts.text: Oceanview Villas sit high along a ridge overlooking the Coral Sea.
facts.excerpt: Oceanview Villas are nestled high along a ridge overlooking the Coral Sea

facts.text: Oceanview Plunge Pool Villas have their own private plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: The stunning location provides access to a collection of secluded beaches and the luxury of your own private plunge pool.

facts.text: The Pavilion sits atop a ridge with panoramic ocean views and a wrap-around deck.
facts.excerpt: The Pavilion sits atop a soaring ridge commanding panoramic ocean views. Glass sliding doors opening onto a majestic wrap around deck

facts.text: The House is a three-storey, three-bedroom property with direct beach access via sandy paths.
facts.excerpt: elegant three storey, three bedroom property offering direct beach access via sandy paths

facts.text: The House is a 4-bedroom private villa of concrete and copper.
facts.excerpt: A brutalist concrete and copper 4-bedroom private villa

facts.text: Essentia Spa treatments are built around Sodashi products.
facts.excerpt: Essentia Spa offers a wide range of Sodashi products to take your spa experience home with you.

facts.text: The Crystal Vitality Facial is unique to Lizard Island.
facts.excerpt: Crystal Vitality Facial – Unique to Lizard Island

facts.text: A freshwater swimming pool sits between the Resort Lodge and Essentia Day Spa.
facts.excerpt: Our freshwater swimming pool is centrally located between the Resort Lodge and Essentia Day Spa.

facts.text: Lizard Island Resort caters to children 10 years old and over.
facts.excerpt: Lizard Island Resort caters to children 10 years old and over.

facts.text: Essentia Spa welcomes guests aged 16 and older.
facts.excerpt: Essentia Spa welcomes guests aged 16 years and older to enjoy our facilities and spa treatments.

facts.text: Lizard Island experiences and activities are exclusive to resort guests.
facts.excerpt: Lizard Island experiences and activities are exclusive for resort guests only.

facts.text: Activities include snorkelling, diving, paddle boarding, kayaking, hiking, Research Station visits, night tennis and morning beach yoga.
facts.excerpt: Guided and self-guided activities include snorkelling, diving, paddle boarding, kayaking, hiking, visits to the Lizard Island Research Station, tennis under night lights, morning yoga on the beach

facts.text: The Lizard Island Research Station is a coral reef research facility owned and operated by the Australian Museum.
facts.excerpt: The Lizard Island Research Station is a coral reef research facility, owned and operated by the Australian Museum.

facts.text: Activities are best reserved before arrival.
facts.excerpt: Best to reserve your activities before you get there, including snorkelling, diving, and touring the research facility.

facts.text: Divers may not fly for at least 24 hours after their last dive, and most guests fly to and from the island.
facts.excerpt: divers are not permitted to fly for a minimum of 24 hours after their last dive. As most guests will fly to and from the island

facts.text: The island is about two hundred kilometers north of Cairns.
facts.excerpt: Two hundred kilometers north of Cairns and totally secluded

facts.text: Lizard Island was declared a National Park in 1937.
facts.excerpt: Lizard Island was declared a National Park in 1937

facts.text: Delaware North operates Lizard Island Resort.
facts.excerpt: Delaware North continues to operate all aspects of Lizard Island Resort

facts.text: Biodigestors across the resort remove the need to ship food waste to the mainland.
facts.excerpt: Biodigestors have been installed across the resort, eliminating the need to transport food waste to the mainland.

facts.text: An easy 10-minute swim reaches the fringing reef.
facts.excerpt: An easy 10-minute swim will have you on the fringing reef

facts.text: The island is home to its namesake monitor lizards.
facts.excerpt: including its namesake dragon-like monitor lizards, which are gentler than they look

facts.text: A twilight cruise runs at dusk on MV Nemo in Anchor Bay.
facts.excerpt: Running at dusk, on ‘MV Nemo’ in Anchor Bay, to capture the magical sunset at Lizard Island

facts.text: Guided glass bottom kayak tours cross Anchor Bay.
facts.excerpt: Cruise across Anchor Bay with a guided tour in a glass bottom kayak

facts.text: The Beachfront Suite is wheelchair accessible.
facts.excerpt: The Beachfront Suite is accessible – i.e. wheelchair access, handrails, and accessible toilet and shower.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler named the resort to its Gold List 2025.
facts.excerpt: Gold List 2025

facts.text: Lizard Island Resort is the only all-inclusive resort in Australia located directly on the reef.
facts.excerpt: Lizard Island Resort is the only all-inclusive resort in Australia located directly on the reef

facts.text: The Marlin Bar is closed to the public during the peak occupancy period.
facts.excerpt: The Marlin Bar is closed to the public throughout the peak occupancy period

facts.text: Marlin Bar is a public bar.
facts.excerpt: It’s also a public bar
